newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Petrobras privatization clause voted later.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Petrobras privatization clause voted later.

text.p: An amendment to Brazil's petroleum bill, allowing for the privatization of state oil monopoly Petrobras, will be put to a vote only when the legislation reaches the floor of the Chamber of Deputies, a lawmaker said.

Deputy Jose Carlos Aleluia, who proposed the amendment, said his Liberal Front Party, along with other government-allied parties, were withdrawing their amendments from committee-level voting and would only present them again once the bill had been approved on the floor of the lower house.
Earlier Tuesday, a lower house committtee approved 23-4 a bill opening up Brazil's petroleum industry to the private sector.
Aleluia's amendment would eliminate an article of the bill which obliges the Brazilian state to maintain a controlling stake in Petrobras.
Government whips have said they hope to put the bill to a vote on the floor of the lower house as soon as possible, perhaps as early as this week.
